title: Hello, Cat!
body:
Goal: make the cat say hello, walk, meow and say bye, in that order. Tool: Scratch app (offline). Work in pairs: driver clicks, navigator reads these steps. Swap when the timer rings.

Build steps

  1. Open the Scratch app. You will see the cat on the stage.
  2. Click Events (yellow circle). Drag when green flag clicked into the code area.
  3. Click Motion. Snap go to x: (0) y: (0) under it. (0, 0 is the middle of the stage.)
  4. Click Looks. Snap say (Hello!) for (2) seconds. Click the text and type Hi! I am plus your nickname.
  5. Click Motion. Snap move (10) steps and change 10 to 100.
  6. Click Sound. Snap play sound (Meow) until done.
  7. Click Looks. Snap another say (...) for (2) seconds and type Bye!.
  8. Click the green flag to test.
  9. Save: File > Save to your computer, folder Scratch Projects, name hello-cat.

The script in words

Cat sprite, one script:

  • when green flag clicked
  • go to x: 0 y: 0
  • say "Hi! I am Pixel Panda" for 2 seconds (use your own nickname)
  • move 100 steps
  • play sound Meow until done
  • say "Bye!" for 2 seconds

Expected behavior

When you click the green flag, the cat jumps to the middle, says hello with your nickname, walks to the right, meows, and says "Bye!". Clicking the flag again plays the same show from the middle.

Checklist

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: Read the goal again: say hello, walk, meow, say bye. Scratch runs blocks from the top down, so your stack should follow that same order. Look at the block categories on the left side of the screen.

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: Start with a yellow Events block, when green flag clicked. Then add blocks one at a time from Motion, Looks and Sound. Click the flag after each new block to see what it does.

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: You need two say ( ) for ( ) seconds blocks from Looks, and they are not next to each other. Between them, you need a walking block, move ( ) steps from Motion, with the number left for you to choose, and a block from Sound that plays the meow.
